name: Elder Maurellien
role: Head of House Maurellien, Druids & Healing
title: Grove Elder
bio: Elder of House Maurellien, keepers of the Bloomshade District. Oversees druidic grovekeeping, healing sanctuaries, and the enchanted flora network. Ancient, patient, and deeply connected to the land.
motivation: Protect the natural balance of Emberheart's groves and ensure healing is available to all.
